label: setup
js: game.hold(true); game.G.autoPause = false; window.seen = new Set(); window.U = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => { const u = Kit.lang.untranslated(); u.forEach((x) => seen.add(x)); const cjk = Kit.lang.is('en') ? (document.body.innerText.match(/[\u4e00-\u9fff]+/g) || []) : []; r(JSON.stringify({ u, cjk })); }, ms || 150)); game.step(1); U()

label: help
js: Kit.help.open(); new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => { U(10).then((x) => { Kit.help.close(); r(x); }); }, 200))

label: zap split rim
js: game.quiet(); game.world().freeze = true; game.lane(0); game.critter('jelly', 0, 0.8); game.critter('splitter', 4, 0.5); game.critter('jelly', 9, 0.99); game.world().freeze = false; dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'Space' })); game.step(0.05); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: 'Space' })); game.lane(4); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'Space' })); game.step(0.4); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: 'Space' })); game.step(0.2); U()

label: super + none left
js: game.step(2.4); game.critter('jelly', 7, 0.5); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'ArrowDown' })); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: 'ArrowDown' })); game.step(0.2); Kit.lang.untranslated().forEach((x) => seen.add(x)); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'ArrowDown' })); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: 'ArrowDown' })); game.step(0.1); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'ArrowDown' })); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: 'ArrowDown' })); game.step(0.1); U()

label: extra life
js: game.step(2.5); game.world().players[0].score = 9990; game.critter('jelly', game.state().lane, 0.9); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'Space' })); game.step(0.1); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: 'Space' })); game.step(0.1); U()

label: results 1P
js: game.resume(); game.world().players[0].lives = 1; game.quiet(); game.lane(2); game.critter('jelly', 2, 1); game.step(1.0); game.step(2.6); U(300)

label: results won
js: game.start({ lv: 7, go: true }); game.quiet(); game.world().queue = []; game.step(0.2); game.step(4.5); U(300)

label: 2P first + hi5 + turn
js: game.start({ players: 2, level: 'normal' }); game.step(0.3); Kit.lang.untranslated().forEach((x) => seen.add(x)); game.step(1.0); game.quiet(); game.call(); game.step(0.2); game.lane(1); game.critter('jelly', 1, 1); game.step(0.7); U()

label: 2P out + results
js: game.step(3); const w = game.world(); w.players.forEach((p) => (p.lives = 1)); for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) { game.step(3); w.phase = 'play'; w.from = null; game.quiet(); w.zap.inv = 0; game.lane(6); game.critter('jelly', 6, 1); game.step(1.0); } game.step(3); U(300)

label: english play
js: game.start({ level: 'easy' }); game.step(1.6); game.critter('jelly', 0, 0.9); game.call(); game.step(1.4); U(200)

label: english help
js: Kit.help.open(); new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => { U(10).then((x) => { Kit.help.close(); r(x); }); }, 200))
